mapper.insert: insert into social_chat_conversation ( user_a, user_b, last_sender_id, last_message, last_message_time, user_a_unread, user_b_unread, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{userA}, #{userB}, #{lastSenderId}, #{lastMessage}, now(), 0, 0, now(), now() )
mapper.update: update social_chat_conversation set last_sender_id = #{lastSenderId}, last_message = #{lastMessage}, last_message_time = now(), updated_at = now(), user_a_unread = case when user_a = #{receiverUserId} then user_a_unread + 1 else user_a_unread end, user_b_unread = case when user_b = #{receiverUserId} then user_b_unread + 1 else user_b_unread end where conversation_id = #{conversationId}
mapper.select: select c.conversation_id, case when c.user_a = #{userId} then c.user_b else c.user_a end as peer_user_id, p.nickname as peer_nickname, p.avatar_url as peer_avatar_url, p.city_code as peer_city_code, p.profession as peer_profession, c.last_message, c.last_sender_id, c.last_message_time, case when c.user_a = #{userId} then c.user_a_unread else c.user_b_unread end as unread_count from social_chat_conversation c inner join social_user_profile p on p.user_id = case when c.user_a = #{userId} then c.user_b else c.user_a end where c.user_a = #{userId} or c.user_b = #{userId} order by c.last_message_time desc, c.updated_at desc

select message_id, conversation_id, from_user_id, to_user_id, message_type, content, read_status, created_at from social_chat_message where conversation_id = #{conversationId} order by created_at asc, message_id asc
mapper.update: update social_chat_conversation set user_a_unread = case when user_a = #{readerUserId} then 0 else user_a_unread end, user_b_unread = case when user_b = #{readerUserId} then 0 else user_b_unread end, updated_at = now() where conversation_id = #{conversationId}
